intent: Compose fast routing, definition closure, ontology selector locking, Necessary Context Basis construction, dual-lane Context Window Views, semantic reduction, refresh, receipts, and authority-separation obligations as the candidate Agent Reasoning Engine system boundary.

required_conditions: request context routes to the nearest supported capability without a Goal fallback
the selected route determines the required definition relation profile
definition closure reaches a deterministic least fixed point or reports typed semantic gaps
the ontology selector lock contains only owner-declared required edges and recursively required endpoints
a non-authorizing omission audit cannot widen or authorize the selector lock
the Necessary Context Basis is complete and current before route-owned strategy or work
every Context Window View declares plan-bound or interaction-bound identity semantics
one typed semantic result and reasoning receipt are emitted
every completion receives a consequence assessment
only a sole non-consequential continuation is direct
multiple or consequential choices stop at a Decision Gate
dependency drift creates a successor context epoch
partial implementations do not imply whole-engine realization
body.implementation_status: candidate authored system model with bounded partial realizations
